logout.consequence: Removes your login and the authenticator from this phone
logout.offline: Needs a connection: logging out also ends your session on the university server
logout.confirmText:
This removes from this phone:
• your login, so you need your password to get back in
• the PoliTO Authenticator key, so you need to set up the authenticator again before it can approve logins

Your courses, exams and tickets stay on the university servers.
